title: Live Nation Keeps 3 Cents Per Concert Dollar
description:
Live Nation barely profits from concerts. The money is in your ticket.

Sources:
- Live Nation Entertainment full-year and Q4 2025 results: https://news.livenationentertainment.com/news/live-nation-entertainment-full-year-and-fourth-quarter-2025-results

Figures are from company filings and reporting cited above. Not financial advice.

scenes.narration: Live Nation barely profits from concerts. The money is in your ticket.
Concerts look huge. But the margin? Just 3.3 percent.
Ticketing is the opposite. About 37 percent.
So tickets made 1.1 billion in adjusted profit. Concerts? 0.7.
Shows bring the crowd. But tickets bring the profit.
